diff --git a/docs/development/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md b/docs/development/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md
index 278bfb6a..8093a39d 100644
--- a/docs/development/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md

@@ -36,6 +36,41 @@ Before committing, run `make hooks` (once per clone) and `make verify`; inspect
 - Use generic names and example domains in public docs. Escape untrusted text in console and log output; avoid recording private IPs or real service names.
 - Maintain user-visible documentation and machine-readable MCP schemas in English. Reply to the requester in their explicitly requested language or this conversation's language by default.
 
+## Fast development, strict acceptance
+
+Default to the existing authorized Box, worktree, local Git objects, toolchain,
+caches and verified fixture. Observe identity, ownership, dirty/staged work and
+original Operations at resume and meaningful changes, not before every edit.
+Reuse immutable context. Consult GitHub for changed or missing facts; fetch
+only when a required revision is absent or remote reconciliation is due.
+A cached ref is not proof of the live remote head.
+
+Group related inspection, edits and focused tests into bounded local operations.
+Avoid another Exec against a known busy resource while the original is pending;
+do independent reads or work on a genuinely independent authorized resource.
+Review and commit coherent, locally verified slices inside the Box. Accumulate
+compatible commits; run affected/adjacent regression on the combined exact
+candidate. Publish at a meaningful CI boundary: a native result needed for a
+decision, coherent stage, high-risk change needing independent evidence,
+durable handoff/backup requirement, or final acceptance. Do not submit every
+small edit or create a fresh Box/worktree for every checkpoint. No fixed batch size.
+
+Reuse populated labs for suitable iterative tests; use a clean independent
+fixture for fresh install, schema/absence, isolation, reproducibility or other
+gates whose oracle requires it. Preserve required native and exact-head CI.
+Cache hits, earlier SHA results and reused labs are not independent clean
+acceptance. Invalidate affected evidence on relevant change; reconcile drift
+or conflicting ownership. Never bypass admission, replay UNKNOWN, reset dirty
+work, or weaken a test.
+
+Local commits are not independent backup. Record local branch, base, HEAD/tree,
+original receipts, evidence and next action outside the Box; ensure actual bytes
+are durably stored when required. Prefer normal fast-forward publication of
+local commits. If only the authorized GitHub tree API works, a recorded
+aggregate commit may represent their exact final tree; retain local commits
+and mapping, verify remote tree and expected parent before advancing the ref.
+Do not pretend local commit IDs were published.
+
 ## Development environment and Box lifecycle
 
 This is the default end-to-end developer workflow, not a new runtime feature or a requirement that BoxWeave already work to develop BoxWeave.
diff --git a/docs/development/CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md b/docs/development/CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md
index 84089eb7..92e85e2b 100644
--- a/docs/development/CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md
+++ b/docs/development/CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@ There are no supported production users or data to migrate before the first stab
 
 1. Resume the actual PR HEAD, current phase, dirty work, original operations and pending CI; reconcile any divergence before editing. Use an authorized isolated Box/worktree first, with clean independent nested Incus fixture when feasible. Do not replace the active controller used to manage the development environment. Where native capability is genuinely unavailable, record its precise limitation and use an independent clean runner; source work need not stop.
 2. Reproduce and test each coherent slice in the Box; format before committing, verify the applicable source/native regressions and preserve exact evidence. Transfer sanitized results to the PR. Push coherent checkpoints to the same topic branch so applicable CI runs independently; do not push broken intermediate states merely to generate CI.
+   Apply [fast local reuse and strict acceptance](AGENT_WORKFLOW.md#fast-development-strict-acceptance): locally verify and commit compatible slices in the same worktree, then submit a coherent candidate at a meaningful CI boundary. All independent gates and durable handoff remain mandatory.
 3. While CI is queued/running, continue Box-first development on the next safe ready slice or independent phase work. A pending run is not PASS. Do not advance a dependent irreversible/safety-critical action on unproven assumptions. Distinguish BOX_VERIFIED, CI_PENDING, CI_FAILED, CI_VERIFIED, BLOCKED and COMPLETE; record exact commit, run/attempt and job. Preserve prior runs even if newer commits make them stale.
 4. When CI reports a concrete failure, inspect the actual job/log and exact SHA, reproduce in the Box where possible, determine product vs fixture vs environment vs infrastructure cause, fix the still-applicable defect on the current branch, rerun the failing and adjacent cases, and submit the correction. Do not weaken tests to make green; if an older failure is already fixed, link the fixing commit and fresh evidence. Continue unaffected work; stop dependent work on unresolved safety failures. Do not spin waiting for CI or discard failure evidence.
 5. At each phase checkpoint update progress, inventory and acceptance mapping. Use ordinary BDH Solve/Evolve loops and record applicable learning dispositions with evidence; independently review reusable changes, regression and Eval before promotion. Continue until the requested scope is complete or genuine blocker/budget boundary. Final exact HEAD must pass all applicable independent gates; previous green runs are not final acceptance.
